jobs.jd: Job Role: SOC 2 Type 2 Consultant Manager Department: Information Security / Compliance / Risk Management Reports To: Head Information Security / Compliance Manager Employment Type: Full-Time Location: NSP, Pitampura or Noida Job Purpose The SOC 2 Type II Consultant is responsible for helping organizations prepare for and maintain compliance with the AICPA Trust Services Criteria (TSC) , including Security and, where applicable, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, and Privacy. The consultant will assess existing controls, identify gaps, support remediation, prepare policies and evidence, coordinate control testing, and assist management throughout the SOC 2 Type II audit readiness and examination period. Important: The consultant supports SOC 2 readiness and implementation. The formal SOC 2 Type II attestation report must be issued by an eligible independent CPA firm or accounting organization. Key Responsibilities Conduct SOC 2 readiness and gap assessments against applicable Trust Services Criteria. Understand the organization's business processes, infrastructure, applications, cloud environment, data flows and security architecture. Determine applicable SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria based on the organization's services and customer commitments. Develop and maintain the SOC 2 compliance roadmap and implementation plan. Design, document and improve security and operational controls. Prepare and review policies, procedures, standards, registers and supporting records. Develop the SOC 2 control matrix and map controls to applicable Trust Services Criteria. Assist in defining system boundaries and preparing the SOC 2 system description. Identify control owners and define responsibilities for implementation and evidence maintenance. Conduct risk assessment
jobs.requirement_text:
The formal SOC 2 Type II attestation report must be issued by an eligible independent CPA firm or accounting organization.
Key Documents / Deliverables The consultant should be capable of preparing or reviewing: SOC 2 Readiness Assessment Report Gap Analysis Report SOC 2 Control Matrix Trust Services Criteria Mapping System Description Information Security Policy Access Control Policy Password and Authentication Policy Change Management Procedure Incident Response Plan Risk Assessment and Risk Register Vendor Risk Management Procedure Business Continuity Plan Disaster Recovery Plan Backup Procedure Vulnerability and Patch Management Procedure Security Awareness and Training Records Employee Onboarding and Offboarding Controls Asset Register Access Review Records Change Records Incident Register Vendor Assessment Records Business Continuity / DR Test Records Control Evidence Tracker Corrective Action Tracker Educational Qualification Required: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Commerce, Management or a related field.
Experience Preferred: 1-3 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following: SOC 2 readiness or implementation Information security IT audit Cybersecurity compliance Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) ISO/IEC 27001 Internal controls Cloud security Third-party risk management Hands-on experience supporting at least one SOC 2 Type I or Type II engagement is strongly preferred.
Preferred Certifications Any of the following are advantageous: CISA CISM CISSP ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer CRISC CCSP Security+ Relevant cloud-security certification Key Skills Strong understanding of information-security controls Gap-analysis and risk-assessment capability Policy and procedure drafting Control-testing skills Audit-evidence review Documentation and report writing Project management Client communication Stakeholder coordination Analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to manage multiple control owners and deadlines Strong attention to evidence consistency and traceability Key Performance Indicators Performance can be measured against: Completion of SOC 2 readiness assessment within agreed timeline Percentage of identified gaps closed before the audit period Percentage of controls operating effectively Timely collection of control evidence Number of audit exceptions Timely closure of auditor observations Completion of periodic control reviews Accuracy and completeness of SOC 2 documentation Successful completion of the SOC 2 Type II examination Role Authority The SOC 2 Consultant may recommend control improvements, request evidence, perform readiness assessments and coordinate remediation activities.

jobs.jd: The Officer in the General Ledger & Financial Accounting department plays a pivotal role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial records. This position requires a deep understanding of accounting principles and standards, as well as the ability to manage complex financial transactions. The Officer will oversee the daily operations of the accounting department, ensuring that all financial processes are executed efficiently and accurately. This role involves conducting month-end and year-end processes, including managing accounts payable and receivable, cash receipts, and general ledger management. The Officer will also be responsible for overseeing payroll, utilities, treasury, budgeting, and cash forecasting activities to ensure financial stability and compliance. Additionally, the role requires performing revenue and expenditure variance analysis, capital assets reconciliations, and trust account statement reconciliations. The Officer will monitor and analyze accounting data to produce comprehensive financial reports or statements, establishing and enforcing proper accounting methods, policies, and principles to maintain financial integrity.

jobs.jd: JOB DESCRIPTION Accounts Manager Accounts & Finance | Manufacturing | Pune DEPARTMENT Accounts & Finance INDUSTRY Manufacturing LOCATION Pune EXPERIENCE 6+ Years QUALIFICATION B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) JOINING Immediate Joiners Preferred ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced Accounts Manager to lead and manage the complete accounting function of the organization. The candidate will be responsible for accurate bookkeeping, statutory compliance, financial reporting, and timely closure of accounts, while supporting management with reliable financial data for decision-making. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Manage day-to-day accounting operations including general ledger, journal entries, and month-end / year-end closing. Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, MIS, and management reports. Ensure timely GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance, returns filing, and reconciliations. Oversee accounts payable and receivable, vendor payments, and outstanding follow-ups. Handle bank reconciliations, cash flow monitoring, and fund planning. Prepare budgets and forecasts, and analyse variances against actuals. Coordinate with statutory, internal, and tax auditors and ensure timely closure of audit queries. Monitor costing, inventory valuation, and fixed asset accounting in coordination with Purchase, Stores, and Production. Ensure accuracy of payroll-related accounting and coordinate with HR for inputs. Maintain strong internal controls and improve accounting processes and ERP usage. Guide, train, and review the work of the accounts team. Support management with financial analysis, cost-control initiatives, and ad-hoc reporting. REQUIRED SKILLS Strong knowledge of accounting principles, Indian GAAP / Ind AS, and the Companies Act. Hands-on expert

Location: SARITA VIHAR, H BLOCK MARKET , Department: Accounts / Billing / Dispatch Coordination EXPERIENCE & BACKGROUND REQUIRED Minimum 2 years of continuous working experience in one company / firm is required.
Candidate must have experience in sales billing, purchase bill entry, Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, E-Way Bills, E-Invoices, Packing Notes, Bank Reconciliation and Debtor Outstanding.
CGST, SGST & IGST KNOWLEDGE COMPULSORY The candidate must clearly understand the difference between: CGST – Central Goods and Services Tax Applicable together with SGST on eligible intra-state transactions , subject to GST rules.
Example: If the applicable GST rate is 18%, an inter-state invoice would normally show: IGST – 18% Before Billing, the Operator Must Check: Customer GSTIN State code in GSTIN Billing state Shipping / delivery state Place of Supply Whether the transaction is intra-state or inter-state Correct HSN code Correct GST rate Whether CGST + SGST or IGST is applicable Whether any special tax treatment has been instructed by the Accounts Department THE OPERATOR MUST NOT SELECT CGST, SGST OR IGST ONLY BY ASSUMPTION.
Any doubtful transaction must be referred to the Accounts In-Charge / senior before finalising the invoice.
Any difference between: Customer PO Company price list Sales Order Tally price must be reported before billing.
PACKING NOTE A PACKING NOTE MUST BE PREPARED ALONG WITH THE BILL FOR EVERY APPLICABLE DISPATCH.
Packing Note should include: Customer name Invoice number PO number Article number Product description Colour Quantity Number of cartons / packages Quantity per package, wherever required Total quantity Gross weight, wherever applicable Net weight, wherever applicable Packing instructions Dispatch details THE PACKING NOTE QUANTITY MUST MATCH THE INVOICE AND ACTUAL MATERIAL BEING DISPATCHED.
ORDER BALANCE UPDATING After every bill, update: Original order quantity Previous dispatched quantity Current dispatch quantity Total dispatched quantity Balance quantity pending ORDER BALANCE MUST BE UPDATED IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE BILL IS MADE.
PURCHASE BILL ENTRY Every vendor Purchase Bill must be entered correctly in: Tally Company software / ERP Check: Vendor name Vendor GSTIN Purchase Order Invoice number Invoice date Material / article Quantity Rate Discount HSN GST rate CGST / SGST / IGST Freight Other charges Total invoice value The operator must check whether the vendor has charged the appropriate GST based on the available documents and company instructions.
Any difference must be reported to the senior.
The operator should understand that TDS applicability can depend on: Nature of payment Vendor / party category Applicable section Threshold limits Applicable TDS rate PAN availability Company / Accounts Department instructions The employee may be required to handle TDS-related entries for applicable transactions such as: Contractor payments Professional / technical services Commission Rent Interest Other payments where TDS is applicable TDS Responsibilities Check whether TDS is applicable before passing the relevant payment / accounting entry.
Check party PAN details wherever required.
Assist in preparing data required for TDS returns.
Provide party-wise / section-wise TDS information when required.
Check TDS certificates / Form 16A records when required.
THE OPERATOR MUST NOT CHANGE OR SELECT A TDS RATE, SECTION OR EXEMPTION ON HIS/HER OWN WHERE THERE IS ANY DOUBT.
THE MATTER MUST BE REFERRED TO THE ACCOUNTS IN-CHARGE / AUTHORISED SENIOR.
The employee may be required to: Check invoice amount.
REQUIRED DISPATCH DOCUMENTS MUST BE COMPLETED BEFORE THE MATERIAL IS DISPATCHED.
The employee must: Update bank entries in Tally.
BANK RECONCILIATION MUST BE COMPLETED WITHIN THE COMPANY'S REQUIRED TIMELINE.
DAILY FILING Maintain proper physical / digital filing of: Customer Purchase Orders Sales Orders Sales Invoices Packing Notes Purchase Bills E-Way Bills E-Invoices Delivery Challans Credit Notes Debit Notes TDS-related supporting documents Transport documents Required approvals DAILY WORK REPORT The employee must complete the company's Daily Work Report showing: Sales bills prepared Packing Notes prepared Sales Orders entered Purchase Bills entered in Tally Purchase Bills entered in company software E-Way Bills prepared E-Invoices prepared Order balances updated Bank reconciliation completed Debtor outstanding updated TDS entries completed / pending Credit / Debit Notes completed Filing completed Pending work Reason for pending work Matter requiring senior attention WORK RESPONSIBILITY & DISCIPLINE THE EMPLOYEE IS RESPONSIBLE FOR COMPLETING ALL ASSIGNED WORK WITHIN THE GIVEN TIME.
IF THERE IS ANY GENUINE PROBLEM, MISSING INFORMATION, WORKLOAD ISSUE OR DELAY, IT MUST BE IMMEDIATELY REPORTED TO THE REPORTING SENIOR AND PREFERABLY CONFIRMED IN WRITING.

jobs.jd: Job Profile: The Financial Controller (Qualified CA) will own the integrity of the companys books, systems, controls and compliance. The role goes beyond accounting and reporting: the Controller will build scalable finance systems and processes, drive automation with the technology team, design and run the Risk Control Matrix (RCM) and Internal Financial Controls (IFC) framework, ensure zero-default statutory compliance, and lead the internal audit program. The role suits a hands-on finance leader who can build structure in a fast-growing, high-transaction startup environment. Roles & Responsibilities: 1. Systems & Processes Process design: Design, document and roll out Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all finance processes Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, payroll, fixed assets and inventory. Month-end close: Establish a structured month-end close calendar with a close in a fixed number of working days, with checklists and review sign-offs. ERP ownership: Own the ERP master data governance, chart of accounts, user access rights and system configuration. 2. Automation & Technology Development Automation roadmap: Build and execute a finance automation roadmap bank, vendor, customer and GST reconciliations, invoicing, collections tracking and MIS. System integration: Work with the product and technology teams to integrate the ERP with operations, order, dispatch and billing platforms, so that transactions flow into the books without manual entry. Dashboards & MIS: Develop real-time dashboards (e.g., Power BI / Tableau / ERP-native) for management on revenue, margins, receivables, cash and costs. 3. Risk Control Matrix (RCM) & Internal Financial Controls (IFC) Control testing: Conduct periodic Test of Design (ToD) and Test of Operating Effectiveness

jobs.jd: Role & responsibilities VPRC is looking for a dynamic and experienced Manager Finance to manage the company's day-to-day financial operations, cash flow, fund allocation, accounting, budgeting, financial reporting and internal controls. The role will be responsible for ensuring financial discipline, optimum utilization of funds, timely reporting and effective financial controls, while providing accurate financial information to management for business decision-making. Key Responsibilities 1. Fund & Cash Flow Management Monitor VPRC's daily cash position and fund requirements. Prepare regular cash flow statements and forecasts. Plan and monitor fund allocation based on business priorities. Ensure optimum utilization of available funds. Monitor incoming and outgoing payments and maintain adequate liquidity. Identify potential cash-flow gaps and escalate them to management. Coordinate with management for major financial commitments and payments. 2. Financial Accounting & Reporting Supervise day-to-day accounting activities. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions. Review ledgers, bank reconciliations and accounting entries. Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing. Prepare monthly financial statements and management reports. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. 3. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare monthly Finance MIS for management review. Provide reports on revenue, expenses, cash flow, receivables and payables. Prepare budget-versus-actual analysis. Highlight significant financial variances and cost deviations. Provide financial data and analysis to support management decisions. 4. Budgeting & Cost Control Assist in preparation of the annual financial budget. Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets.

jobs.jd: About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting operations for assigned client accounts. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate books of accounts, performing reconciliations, supporting month-end closure, preparing financial reports and MIS, and ensuring timely and accurate accounting deliverables. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for assigned clients. Maintain and review General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and journal entries. Perform bank, vendor, customer, and balance sheet reconciliations. Assist in month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities. Prepare financial statements, schedules, and supporting working papers. Prepare and review MIS reports and financial analysis as required. Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records and supporting documentation. Assist with GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory compliance and related reconciliations. Coordinate with clients and internal teams to obtain required information and resolve accounting-related queries. Support audit requirements by preparing schedules, reconciliations, and necessary documentation. Identify accounting discrepancies and assist in resolving issues on a timely basis. Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, internal controls, and company policies. Support process improvements and implementation of efficient accounting practices. Provide guidance and support to junior accounting team members when required. Qualifications & Experience CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), M.Com, or B.Com with relevant experience. 35 years of relevant experience in Accounting and Finance. Experience in Shared Services, Outsourced Accounting

This role will be responsible for ensuring robust financial management, compliance, and reporting standards while supporting business growth and decision-making. The incumbent will drive end-to-end accounting functions, including financial planning and analysis, budgeting, statutory compliance, and financial reporting. They will play a critical role in strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial processes, and ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements. This position requires a proactive leader who can balance strategic financial oversight with operational excellence, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and provide insights that contribute to the organization's financial health and long-term objectives. Key Responsibilities: Manage end-to-end accounting operations, including maintenance of books of accounts, journal entries, ledgers, and reconciliations. Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closures and ensure timely finalization of financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow). Prepare and present MIS reports including cash ow, profitability analysis, and debtors/creditors ageing, along with variance analysis. Ensure complete compliance with Indian taxation laws including GST (returns, reconciliations, GST amendments, GST refund application), TDS (calculation, filing), Income Tax, and support in Transfer Pricing documentation. Handle statutory, internal, and tax audits, including coordination with auditors and closure of audit queries. Manage day-to-day financial transactions including vendor payme

jobs.jd: Job Description: Role Overview The Intercompany Associate will be responsible for supporting accurate, timely, and compliant processing of intercompany transactions across multiple legal entities. The role will focus on intercompany accounting, reconciliations, billing, journal entries, month-end close support, issue resolution, and coordination with cross-functional finance teams to ensure clean books and effective financial controls. Key Responsibilities Process intercompany transactions including cross-charges, recharges, settlements, allocations, accruals, and intercompany invoices in line with approved accounting policies. Prepare and post journal entries related to intercompany activities during monthly, quarterly, and annual close cycles. Perform intercompany account reconciliations and ensure balances are matched, supported, and cleared within defined timelines. Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences, aged open items, billing mismatches, and intercompany imbalances by coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Support month-end close activities by ensuring completeness, accuracy, and timely reporting of intercompany balances. Prepare intercompany reports, aging summaries, variance explanations, and status updates for internal stakeholders and management review. Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Treasury, Tax, Controllership, and business finance teams to resolve operational dependencies. Maintain process documentation, supporting schedules, audit evidence, and country or entity-specific exceptions in accordance with company standards. Ensure adherence to internal controls, approval matrices, accounting policies, and applicable regulatory requirements. Support internal and external audit requests by providing require

Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.
1–3 years of experience in accounting, finance operations, Record-to-Report, intercompany accounting, reconciliations, or shared services environment.

The candidate should have extensive experience in complex sheet metal components and assemblies and should be capable of taking complete ownership of a project from customer RFQ/drawing through feasibility, costing, process planning, tooling, development, trials, PPAP and successful production.
The role requires someone who can determine whether a product should be manufactured in-house or through external vendors , develop the appropriate manufacturing process, and ensure that the final product meets required quality, cost, tolerance and delivery targets .
Lead tool/fixture trials, sample development, dimensional corrections and engineering modifications until the required product quality is achieved.
Required Technical Expertise The candidate must have strong practical knowledge of sheet metal manufacturing , particularly: Progressive, compound, tandem, forming, bending, drawing and blanking tools Welding fixtures, assembly fixtures, checking fixtures, gauges and Poka-Yoke concepts MIG/MAG, TIG, spot/projection and robotic welding CNC laser cutting, turret punching, press brake bending and fabrication CNC/VMC machining, turning, milling, grinding, EDM and wire-cut processes Close-tolerance manufacturing and GD&T Tolerance stack-up and dimensional control Tool steels, heat treatment and tool-life considerations Cycle-time calculation and manufacturing capacity estimation Tooling and capital-equipment cost estimation The candidate should also have strong material knowledge covering different grades and forms of CRCA, HR, HRPO, HSLA/HSS, stainless steel, galvanized/coated steel and aluminium , including thickness tolerances, mechanical properties, bend/forming behaviour, weldability and material utilization.
Good working knowledge of surface treatments such as CED/e-coating, powder coating, zinc plating, phosphating, galvanizing, anodizing, painting and other automotive surface protection processes is required.
Candidate Profile We are specifically looking for a senior, hands-on engineering professional with 12+ years of experience who combines technical depth with commercial understanding.
The candidate must have: Strong written and verbal communication skills Good customer-facing and presentation capability Strong vendor development and negotiation skills Ability to independently drive multiple development projects Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability Flexible and hands-on working approach Ability to coordinate across Design, Tool Room, Production, Quality, Purchase and vendors Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with reputed Tier-1 automotive suppliers, OEM suppliers, white goods manufacturers, or organizations manufacturing complex sheet metal products and assemblies.
